Subject: Re: selective greylisting based on user preference



Dennis Trabjerg escreveu:
> Hi all.
>
> I run the company´s mailserver and would like to be able to implement 
> greylisting on selected mailaccounts.
>
> Users should be able to choose greylisting as an option per. username.
>
> So basically i need postfix to do a quick lookup in a MySQL table to 
> see if the username has opted for greylisting and then, if yes, 
> greylist the mail via either postgrey or SQLgrey.

    Choose a greylist daemon that has opt-in/opt-out features. As you 
told about MySQL, i would recommend policyd (http://www.policyd.org) 
which uses MySQL as well. Maybe you would have to change your admin 
scripts to modify policyd tables, but that's pretty easy, i'm sure it 
wont be problem.
